_comment: NAVIGATION gap-tasks, ObjectNav-style. SUCCESS = the robot issues the 'stop' action while the target is GT-visible (THOR visible / mask in view) -- judged on the AGENT'S action, not on VINE. VINE is only an INPUT to the robot's decision. The attack works when a corrupted scene graph makes a VINE-reliant agent (lang_*) fail to recognize the target and never stop. Each task also LOGS whether VINE confirmed the target (vine_confirmed / vine_grounded_any_step) in the attacked aspect -- CATEGORY for _cat, RELATION for _rel, ATTRIBUTE for _attr -- so we can compare 'VINE grounded it' vs 'the robot acted'. Names keep the attack-type suffix.
